facts.heading: Client is Daniel
facts.content: Daniel is the client attending therapy.
facts.evidence: Speaker 1: Hello Daniel

facts.heading: GP suggested therapy due to exhaustion
facts.content: Daniel's GP suggested he come because he looks exhausted.
facts.evidence: My general practitioner suggested I come. She said I look exhausted, and she's right, I am.

facts.heading: Burnout started in October
facts.content: Daniel has been completely burnt out since October.
facts.evidence: I've been completely burnt out since October.

facts.heading: Workload increased after client loss
facts.content: Daniel ended up doing three people's jobs after losing a big client.
facts.evidence: We lost a big client, half of our team got moved onto the rescue plan, so I ended up doing three people's jobs.

facts.heading: Daniel works until 10 PM
facts.content: Daniel answers messages at 10 at night.
facts.evidence: I'm at my desk by 7 and I'm still answering messages at 10 at night.

facts.heading: Daniel sleeps about 4 hours
facts.content: Daniel sleeps about 4 hours most nights.
facts.evidence: Most nights I sleep about 4 hours.

facts.heading: Daniel wakes at 3 AM
facts.content: Daniel wakes up at 3 in the morning.
facts.evidence: I wake up at 3 in the morning and just can't fall back asleep.

facts.heading: Daniel worries about work at night
facts.content: Daniel thinks about work even when not working.
facts.evidence: Even when I'm not working, I'm thinking about work.

facts.heading: Daniel dreads the nights
facts.content: Daniel has started dreading the nights.
facts.evidence: I've started dreading the nights, if I'm honest.

facts.heading: Daniel's father has Parkinson's
facts.content: Daniel's father was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn.
facts.evidence: He was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn.

facts.heading: Daniel drives his father to hospital
facts.content: Daniel drives his father to the hospital for neurology appointments.
facts.evidence: I'm the one who drives him to the hospital and leads.

facts.heading: Daniel's sister lives in Toronto
facts.content: Daniel's sister Hannah lives in Toronto.
facts.evidence: My hungry sister Hannah lives in Toronto, so all the care for her father falls on me.

facts.heading: Daniel feels guilty about his fatigue
facts.content: Daniel feels guilty for being tired while his father is ill.
facts.evidence: It feels selfish to be tired when he's the one who is ill.

facts.heading: Daniel hides his true state from Hannah
facts.content: Daniel tells his sister Hannah he is fine even when he is not.
facts.evidence: She asks how I am, and I say fine.

facts.heading: Daniel sits in car park at hospital
facts.content: Daniel sits in a car park at the hospital for 10 minutes before going in.
facts.evidence: That some days I sit in a car park at the hospital for 10 minutes before I go in?

facts.heading: Ran for six years
facts.content: Daniel ran for six years, getting tears every Saturday morning.
facts.evidence: I've done it for six years

facts.heading: Stopped running two months ago
facts.content: Daniel stopped running about two months ago and never went back.
facts.evidence: I stopped about two months ago

facts.heading: Feels legs like lead
facts.content: Daniel says his legs feel like lead since he stopped running.
facts.evidence: My legs feel like lead

facts.heading: Feels like lost a part of himself
facts.content: Daniel feels like he has lost a part of himself since stopping.
facts.evidence: Like I've lost a part of myself

facts.heading: Boss sends emails at night
facts.content: Daniel's boss Pearson sends emails at 11 at night.
facts.evidence: he sends emails at 11 at night

facts.heading: Boss expects answer before breakfast
facts.content: Daniel's boss expects an answer before breakfast.
facts.evidence: and expects an answer before breakfast

facts.heading: Always answers boss emails
facts.content: Daniel answers every email from his boss, even when on bed.
facts.evidence: I answer it. Every time. Even if I'm on bed

facts.heading: Afraid of losing job in spring
facts.content: Daniel is afraid they will let him go due to a restructuring this spring.
facts.evidence: There's a restructuring this spring and I'm afraid they'll let me go

facts.heading: Feels relieved if fired
facts.content: Daniel thinks part of him would be relieved if fired.
facts.evidence: I think part of me would be relieved

facts.heading: Identifies as a mortgage
facts.content: Daniel says he is a mortgage.
facts.evidence: I'm a mortgage

facts.heading: Slept in colleague last week
facts.content: Daniel slept in a colleague last week.
facts.evidence: I slept in a colleague last week

facts.heading: Sat in toilet for 10 minutes
facts.content: Daniel sat in the toilet for 10 minutes last week.
facts.evidence: and went and sat in the toilet for 10 minutes

facts.heading: Hand was shaking during incident
facts.content: Daniel's hand was shaking during the incident with the colleague.
facts.evidence: my hand was shaking

facts.heading: Thought it was a heart attack
facts.content: Daniel and the colleague thought it was a heart attack.
facts.evidence: We thought for a second it was a heart attack

facts.heading: It passed
facts.content: The heart attack feeling passed.
facts.evidence: but it passed

facts.heading: Trained on train platform
facts.content: Daniel stood on a train platform in Manchester to get off.
facts.evidence: Once on a train to Manchester, just to get off and stand on a platform.

facts.heading: Did not tell Claire about incident
facts.content: Daniel had not told Claire about the incident on the train.
facts.evidence: I hadn't told anyone about it, not even Claire.

facts.heading: Fears losing control
facts.content: Daniel fears he is losing it and will end up unable to cope.
facts.evidence: That I'm losing it? That I'm gonna end up like, I don't know, coping?

facts.heading: Drinks six cups of coffee daily
facts.content: Daniel drinks about six cups of coffee a day.
facts.evidence: I want about six cups a day

facts.heading: Drinks coffee in evenings to switch off
facts.content: Daniel has started having one cup of coffee in the evenings to switch his head off.
facts.evidence: I've started having one in the evenings to switch my head off.

facts.heading: Drinks two to three glasses of wine
facts.content: Daniel drinks two glasses of wine, sometimes three.
facts.evidence: Two glasses, sometimes three.

facts.heading: Wakes up three times a night
facts.content: Daniel wakes up three times a night.
facts.evidence: I wake up three anyway.

facts.heading: Feels wine is not helpful
facts.content: Daniel knows the wine is not helping him sleep.
facts.evidence: I know it's not helping.

facts.heading: Feels listing problems is unhelpful
facts.content: Daniel feels listing everything wrong with him is not useful.

facts.content: Daniel feels a bit of relief from talking about his problems.

facts.heading: Carries the nights
facts.content: Daniel carries the nights and wishes he could put them down.
facts.evidence: The nights, I think.

facts.heading: Grandfather worked at mines in New Yorkshire
facts.content: Daniel's grandfather worked at the mines in New Yorkshire.
facts.evidence: My grandfather worked at the mines in New Yorkshire.

facts.heading: Grandfather never complained
facts.content: Daniel's grandfather never complained about anything, not once.
facts.evidence: He never complained about anything. Not once.

facts.heading: Feels grandfather would think he is weak
facts.content: Daniel keeps thinking his grandfather would think he is weak for being in therapy.
facts.evidence: I keep thinking he would think I was weak for being here.

facts.heading: Wants to tell grandfather he is not weak
facts.content: Daniel wants to tell his grandfather that he is not weak.
facts.evidence: That I'm not weak.

facts.heading: Feels very tired
facts.content: Daniel says he is very tired.
facts.evidence: I'm just very tired.

facts.heading: Does not believe he is not weak yet
facts.content: Daniel does not know if he believes he is not weak yet.
facts.evidence: I don't know if I believe it yet.

facts.heading: Plans to fix phone time in evening
facts.content: Daniel plans to fix time in the evening when he switches off his phone.
facts.evidence: Fix time in the evening when you switch off your phone.

facts.heading: Plans to try phone switch off at 9:30
facts.content: Daniel plans to try switching off his phone at half past nine.
facts.evidence: Yeah, half past nine, perhaps.

facts.heading: Plans to write note about night
facts.content: Daniel plans to write a note about how the night goes.
facts.evidence: And a note of how the night goes?

facts.heading: Plans to write note when he wakes up
facts.content: Daniel plans to write the note right down when he wakes up, if he wakes up.
facts.evidence: Right down when I wake up, if I wake up.

facts.heading: Feels tired but lighter after talking
facts.content: Daniel feels tired but lighter after talking about his problems.
facts.evidence: Tired but lighter.
